items.title: PCAR Q3 deep dive: margin gains offset supply chain and revenue challenges
items.summary: Trucking company PACCAR (NASDAQ:PCAR) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales rose 19% year on year to $7.94 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.61 per share was 7.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: 5 must-read analyst questions from PACCAR’s Q3 earnings call

items.title: Caterpillar Drops 7% as Moderate Sales Outlook Overshadows Beat; Deere Sits Out the Selloff, PACCAR Dips
items.summary: Caterpillar crushed earnings estimates and posted record orders stretching into 2030, yet the stock cratered while its machinery rivals barely flinched. The gap between what Wall Street expected and what management delivered reveals a fault line worth understanding before the next quarterly test arrives.
